description: What all three windows may reach. Nothing is listed for the updater or for restarting, and the absence is a decision rather than an omission: the front end calls this app's own updates_state, updates_check and updates_install, never plugin:updater|* or plugin:process|*, so a grant would be required by nothing while publishing plugin:updater|download_and_install to the webview — the one route by which a page could replace the bundle without passing the run gate. src-tauri/src/updates.rs records it, the way src-tauri/src/autostart.rs records the same absence for autostart:default.
